title: KV-prefetch profiling and model version pinning for long-sequence onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add an automated profile-and-pin step to the model onboarding pipeline that captures KV-cache behavior and long-sequence performance across sequence-length buckets. The profile output will be published to the model catalog and used by the serving runtime to: (1) recommend/lock default version pins for hosted and dedicated customers, (2) select kernel/quantization strategies per-model, and (3) drive prefetch and prefix-cache heuristics for long-context workloads. The goal is to provide concrete, machine-readable performance signatures (latency percentiles, memory/KV-usage, KV hit-rate by prefix length) so operators and customers can make deterministic version pinning and routing decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding pipeline stage emits profile artifact (schema v2) for a model sample containing per-bucket 50/95/99 latency, token throughput, KV cache hit-rate, peak GPU memory, and observed KV cache growth over sequence length
Model catalog UI and API surface includes published profile URL and a human-readable summary (table + sparklines)
Runtime can consume profile metadata to automatically suggest version pins for a customer plan (hosted/dedicated) with a confidence score
Smoke tests show <10% tail-latency regression when using runtime prefetch hints derived from the profile on long-sequence workloads compared to current baseline
Unit and integration tests for profile generation, ingestion, and model-catalog publishing are in CI and green
